projects.name: PawaCloud Assistant — AI Cloud Advisor
projects.description: AI chatbot with Gemini 2.5 Flash, Rust+PyO3 text processing, SSE streaming, Google OAuth, and PostgreSQL persistence on GCP Cloud Run
projects.longDescription: Full-stack AI advisory chatbot streaming responses in real time via SSE. Python FastAPI backend with Rust+PyO3 text processing (50-100x faster than pure Python), Google Gemini 2.5 Flash for generation, PostgreSQL (Neon) for persistent cross-device chat history, and HMAC-signed Bearer tokens for cross-origin auth. Next.js 16 PWA frontend with TailwindCSS v4, live status dashboard with latency charts and PyO3 benchmarks. Deployed on Cloud Run africa-south1 + Fly.io JNB with Terraform IaC.

projects.name: UniRides — Ride-Sharing Reimagined
projects.description: Production-grade ride-sharing platform with 5 Google Maps APIs, real-time tracking, Kenyan market-rate pricing, and FastAPI backend on GCP Cloud Run
projects.longDescription: Full-stack Uber/Bolt-class ride-sharing app for the Kenyan market. Next.js 16 PWA frontend with satellite map view, Google Places Autocomplete for pickup/dropoff, Directions API route polylines, Distance Matrix live ETA with dynamic polling (3s active, 10s accepted), and client-side fare calculation using post-2025 Kenyan market rates (KES 35/km aligned with Bolt/Uber after the 50% fare increase). FastAPI backend with async SQLAlchemy 2.0, Neon PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis, JWT auth, WebSocket ride tracking, and structured logging. Deployed on Fly.io (frontend) + GCP Cloud Run (backend) with scale-to-zero for $0 idle cost.

projects.name: BSD Engine — Business Services Diagnostic
projects.description: Full-stack business diagnostics platform with Rust scoring engine, Next.js 16 dashboard, Recharts visualizations, and AI narrative generation via AWS Bedrock
projects.longDescription: Assesses operational execution maturity across 7 weighted indicators using a 23-question Likert-scale survey. Rust backend scores responses, classifies severity, and generates rich visual reports (radar, bar, area, gap, pie charts) plus AI-powered executive narratives via Bedrock Claude Haiku. Shareable report URLs with OG images, dark-themed print/PDF export with BSD branding.

projects.name: Wave Application — ML Engineer
projects.description: Full-stack polyglot submission for Wave's Senior ML Engineer role with Next.js 16 PWA, Rust+PyO3 Lambda backend, and AWS CDK infrastructure
projects.longDescription: Ships a working product as the application itself. Next.js 16 dashboard with real-time health probes, persistent Upstash Redis submissions, and manual Wave API trigger. Rust+PyO3 backend on AWS Lambda with Bedrock (Claude 3 Haiku sentiment, Titan Embeddings), SageMaker (XLM-RoBERTa 20-language detection), and EventBridge fan-out. 4 CDK stacks, CI/CD with auto-resume submission.
